.. change::
    :tags: bug, orm
    :tickets: 13600

    Fixed issue where an exception raised while committing the database
    transaction inside :meth:`_orm.Session.commit` could leave the ORM
    transaction in the ``PREPARED`` state. The session now rolls back and
    restores its snapshot when the database ``COMMIT`` or savepoint release
    fails, allowing the session to be closed or reused consistently with the
    flush-failure recovery path.
